about: Keys a keyboard shortcut set (keys.json) may not use. Read by the window (lib/keys/registry.ts) and by the service (crates/thoughtsd/src/keys.rs), so both refuse the same ones. Bindings are canonical: Mod (Cmd on a Mac, Ctrl elsewhere), Control, Alt, Shift, Super, then a KeyboardEvent.code. 'Super+*' means any binding that uses the Windows key.
